verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own docs say DNS is part of its offering and can be managed programmatically through its API, with DNS records reviewable through its MCP server. That confirms first-party DNS management exists, but nothing in the pack describes how deep it goes. missing for 10: list of supported record types, TTL limits or low-TTL support, any description of the DNS management UI, confirmation that DNS hosting is included free with the domain, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, full DNS hosting comes with the domain — every record type, low TTLs, and a management UI that doesn't fight me

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities.
Dynadot is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar offering domain registration, aftermarket services, DNS, ema
